import os

# Compute SHA-256 hash of 'Hello, World!' message
message = b'Hello, World!' 
hash_value = rsa.compute_hash(message, 'SHA-256')

# Generate a 512-bit RSA key pair
pub_key, priv_key = rsa.newkeys(512)

# Sign the hash with the private key
signature = rsa.sign_hash(hash_value, priv_key, 'SHA-256')

# Get the length of the resulting signature
signature_length = len(signature)

print(f'SHA-256 hash: {hash_value}')
print(f'RSA key pair generated: {pub_key}, {priv_key}')
print(f'Signature length: {signature_length}')"}
